cohort: Women with type III FGM who gave birth between January 2008 and December 2009
finding: Adherence to clinical management guidelines for women with type III FGM was low, particularly regarding child protection documentation, and while not statistically significant, women who underwent intrapartum deinfibulation experienced higher blood loss and more tears compared to those with antenatal deinfibulation.
mod_finding: Women who had intrapartum deinfibulation had a higher average blood loss and more tears than those deinfibulated antenatally, although this was not statistically significant.
